title: Click-to-source: the draglint:// handler
summary: Registers draglint:// so a chart row opens its line in RAD Studio; a GUI helper exe, no PowerShell
intro: Run drag-lint protocol register once per user (the installer does it); status says what is registered; unregister undoes it. The handler drag-lint-open.exe validates the link before anything else and writes to the plugin's pipe; with no IDE running it opens the file in Notepad.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint protocol register [--handler <drag-lint-open.exe>] [--dry-run] [--force] (HKCU\Software\Classes\draglint -> the handler; --force accepts a *-wt\ path or replaces a foreign registration)
help: drag-lint protocol register [--handler <drag-lint-open.exe>] [--dry-run] [--force]   (HKCU\Software\Classes\draglint -> the handler; --force accepts a *-wt\ path or replaces a foreign registration)
drag-lint protocol unregister [--dry-run] [--force]   (removes the key when it is ours or the legacy PowerShell one; foreign needs --force)
drag-lint protocol status [--json]   (prints the registered command and ours|legacy-powershell|foreign|none; exit 0 only when ours)

questions.ask: Make a chart row open its line in RAD Studio
Is it registered, and to what?
